parent_objective: materialize run-dir-only candidate config artifacts from M2384 design and M2382 application-plan artifacts
blocked_by: M2384 designs candidate config generation but does not materialize generated files
reset validation and repair execution remain blocked until candidate config generation is materialized and synthesized
supersedes: direct reset validation from application-plan artifacts
direct active config overwrite from candidate generation design

public_gates: M2385 must materialize candidate config files under its run directory only
M2385 must preserve active-config overwrite, actor-input, oracle-feature, profile-tuning, collision, R4, diagnostic, and mixed guarded constraints
M2385 must not run reset rollout measured execution repair execution training replay PPO private holdout ranking or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims
forbidden_shortcuts: do not inject hidden or oracle features
do not rank support policies or controller families
do not overwrite the active scenario config
do not write candidate config files outside the M2385 run directory
do not claim finite-window vs GRU conclusion
do not claim scenario redesign executed
do not claim training repair success

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes run-dir-only candidate config artifacts from application-plan artifacts without active overwrite or validation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: artifact-only candidate config generation; no active config overwrite, reset/rollout, repair execution, ranking, paper verdict, finite-window-vs-GRU, self-ID, scenario-redesign-executed, training-repair, or current-sim verdict claim
stop_condition: stop if active config overwrite occurs
stop if candidate config files are written outside the run directory
stop if generated candidate configs drop reward, curriculum, or guardrail references
stop if any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
fallback_plan: route to result/failure synthesis for any artifact mismatch
route to generation design repair if schema is insufficient
route to M2386 branch synthesis if gates pass
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2384 admits run-dir-only candidate config generation

admission_evidence: M2384 defines candidate config generation schema and pass gates
allowed_updates: M2385 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for branch synthesis
next_stage_criteria: candidate config files exist under the run directory
source candidate spec count matches M2382

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2385 materializes candidate config files and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: No wrong-history reset-hidden zero-history or finite-window-vs-GRU verdict is run in M2385.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M2382 application-plan artifacts, M2383 audit, and M2384 design.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: Generated candidate configs remain engineering artifacts and cannot be interpreted as driver capability improvements until validation.
allowed_claims: no controller ranking, paper-level result, finite-window-vs-GRU result, scenario-redesign-executed result, training-repair result, current-sim verdict, or level3 self-identification claim

local_search_guard.evidence_expansion: adds candidate config artifacts from application-plan route but does not yet test capability
local_search_guard.paper_verdict_delta: can admit branch synthesis but cannot establish paper verdict
must_synthesize_if: M2385 cannot materialize candidate config artifacts
M2385 produces candidate config artifacts but no branch synthesis route
the repair-plan materialization branch reaches 10 milestones without synthesis

hypothesis: Artifact-only materialization can generate candidate config files under the run directory from application-plan artifacts without active config overwrite, reset validation, repair execution, ranking, or training-success claims.
success_criteria: active_config_overwritten is false and active_config_patch_application_count is 0
actor_input_change_count hidden_oracle_feature_injection_count profile_specific_tuning_count ranking_admissible_count winner_selected_count are 0
environment_rollout_started policy_action_executed repair_execution_started training_started replay_started ppo_used are false
paper-level finite-window-vs-GRU level3 self-ID scenario-redesign-executed training-repair-success and current-sim verdict claims are false
failure_criteria: candidate config file count differs from 54
candidate config files are written outside the run directory
any forbidden execution or claim flag is set
M2386 branch synthesis route is missing
decision_rule: M2385 passes if it generates candidate config files under the run directory without active config overwrite, reset/rollout, ranking, training, or paper/self-ID/current-sim verdict claims, then routes to branch synthesis.
